name: lumi-skill-cad-drafting
description: CAD and renovation design delivery pack with visible AutoCAD MCP playback, space programs, customer-facing proposal decks, editable DXF drafts, Revit/Dynamo handoff data, and drawing QA checklists.

lumi.setupNote: Reads local renovation folders, generates explicit CAD file deliverables, and visibly plays validated drawing operations into Windows AutoCAD through Lumi MCP COM automation. Visible AutoCAD execution has no generated-file, LISP, SCRIPT, batch-command, or cursor fallback. This is not an Autodesk-official MCP server. Production drawings still require professional verification.
